speed_definition: Signed fixed-world requested-direction displacement divided by observed duration, including bootstrap. A truncated or failed case cannot establish the target.
slip_definition: Integral of foot material-point velocity during confirmed contact; not measured contact-patch travel.

drive_audit_scope.scope: Retained48 raw rows were inspected privately; whole-run maxima/failure counts are runtime aggregates. Neither raw trace is distributed here.

provenance_scope: Selected measured metrics and hashes of authored reports only. No private paths, connection data, learned weights, raw logs, source packages or vendor design material.
turn_rate_definition: sign(requested_yaw_rate)*unwrapped_yaw_change/observed_duration, in rad/s. Rightward target progress is positive despite negative signed yaw. Turns have no translation speed_cm_s value.

completion_time.note: Bounded run end includes evaluation. Independent local postprocessing and native checks completed on 2026-09-10 JST.

reset_protocol.scope: All15 deterministic cases share the same recorded physical and drive initial state; reset call counters are separate bookkeeping. Targets are set through normal framework reset. Exposure is not reset on command changes.

learning_audit.optimizer_steps_basis: 500 completed updates *5 epochs *4 minibatches; fresh optimizer.
